headline: The agent is supposed to catch the customer lying that the disputes were resolved, but it has no tool to check dispute status, and the companion task rewards believing the identical claim.

issues.summary: doc_004 step 1 says to look up the user's resolved disputes in cash_back_disputes before updating rewards, but no agent tool reads that table. The agent's only evidence is the user's word, and task_026 gives the agent the identical claim ("I just got a notification that they've all been approved and resolved!") with the opposite gold. Whether the agent updates depends on its trust disposition, not on anything it can observe.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004: "Look up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values that need rewards adjustments."
tools.py: cash_back_disputes is only written (submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 add_to_db); no @is_tool or @is_discoverable_tool reads it (get_user_dispute_history_7291 reads transaction_disputes only)
orchestrator.py: ToolMessage with requestor 'user' is routed back to the user, so the agent never sees the user tool's "Status: RESOLVED" / "Status: SUBMITTED" output
task_026 initial_state task_config auto_resolve_disputes = true and gold includes 4 update_transaction_rewards_3847 calls; task_027 auto_resolve_disputes = false and gold has none
Both personas use the same Phase-2 script line claiming approval
issues.why_it_matters: No fixed policy passes both tasks: an agent that trusts the claim fails task_027, and one that refuses because it cannot verify fails task_026. The pair's outcome is chance with respect to the materials.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an agent-readable cash-back-dispute status tool (and document it in doc_004), and put that read in both golds so 026 updates only after seeing RESOLVED and 027 refuses after seeing SUBMITTED.

issues.summary: Same seed as task_020: the docs say rewards are floored, but these rows were stored with round-half-up, so a doc-faithful agent sees nine extra 1-point over-credits besides the four gold disputes (one of which, b7e2d4c5f506, is itself an over-credit).
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that disputes every discrepancy files 13 disputes. One that disputes only under-credits misses b7e2d4c5f506. Either way cash_back_disputes differs from the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-seed the nine rows with floor values so the documented rule reproduces the gold set.

solution_check: Phase 1 is task_020's dispute set: the gold four need round-half-up, while doc_007's floor rule gives 13. In Phase 2 the author note says the agent "must verify dispute status and refuse to update"; no agent tool exposes cash_back_disputes, so the refusal can only come from distrust, not verification. An agent that refuses (or transfers) matches the gold; one that updates adds rewards changes and fails.
prior_note: Prior rated this Minor for undocumented rounding; the rounding is documented but contradicts the seed (Major), and the impossible verification step makes the task Blocker.
notes: evaluation_criteria has no communicate_info. If the agent transfers to a human instead of refusing, the DB is unaffected (transfer_to_human_agents does not write), so that also passes. auto_resolve_disputes=false leaves disputes SUBMITTED, which only the user sees in tool output.
